info.name: gsm-system 2.1 / 2.1 API
info.description:
The /api/v1-only contract. A new preset store contains editable defaults "0" through "4". Read requests run by default. Preset CRUD persists data but never starts a cell. The CRUD fixture uses the separate lab-900 ID and never edits/deletes a default. Every mutation is guarded by enable_mutations; cell starts additionally require enable_rf_start=true and have no automatic RF tests. HTTP 202 for SMS means submitted, never delivered. Replace placeholders; do not save real IMSIs, numbers, tokens, or hosts. network names the container interface (default bridge: eth0), not a host NIC.

仅包含 /api/v1。新预设库包含 ID "0" 至 "4" 的五套可编辑默认配置；CRUD 夹具使用独立 lab-900，不会修改或删除默认项。所有写操作需 enable_mutations；启动小区还需 enable_rf_start=true，且不自动执行 RF 测试。
Exact factory-value assertions are opt-in with verify_factory_defaults=true; normal reads validate only resource structure and the selected default_preset_id. / 精确工厂值断言仅在 verify_factory_defaults=true 时执行；常规读取只校验结构和所选 ID。

Cell start has separate Preset and Custom requests. start_preset_id selects any stored preset; default_preset_id is for read-only queries, preset_id remains the CRUD fixture. Custom fields are all variables (including band and short_name). Missing switches or malformed/unresolved start inputs are explained in Postman Console before skipping. Variables follow Postman scope precedence; empty/false environment values do not fall back to collection values. Select one request manually, not Run collection/folder. / 小区启动分为预设和自定义两项；start_preset_id 用于启动，default_preset_id 用于只读查询，preset_id 仍是 CRUD 测试项。自定义全部字段可配置；开关或参数问题会在 Console 说明后跳过，空或 false 环境值不会回退至集合。请选择一项 Send，不要全量运行。

request.description: Control-plane health, version/revision, cell state; not RF acceptance. / 管理面健康，不是射频验收。

exec: pm.test('HTTP 200 stopped health', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.ok).to.eql(true); pm.expect(d.version).to.eql('2.1.0'); pm.expect(d.cell.state).to.eql('stopped'); pm.expect(d.cell.ready).to.eql(false); });

pm.test('HTTP 200 stopped process snapshot', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.state).to.eql('stopped'); pm.expect(d.ready).to.eql(false); pm.expect(d.sms_ready).to.eql(false); pm.expect(d.voice_ready).to.eql(false); pm.expect(d.running).to.eql(false); });

pm.test('HTTP 200 no saved profile', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.has_profile).to.eql(false); pm.expect(d).not.to.have.property('profile'); });
pm.test('HTTP 200: seeded OpenBTS DB exists', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('config is a non-empty key/value array', function () { const a=pm.response.json().data.config; pm.expect(a).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(a[0].key).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(a[0].value).to.be.a('string'); });

request.description: Volatile observation, not an online assertion. / 易失观察，不是在线判定。

exec: pm.test('HTTP 412: cell is intentionally stopped', () => pm.response.to.have.status(412));
pm.test('HTTP 200: seeded registry DB exists', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('clean registry is an empty paginated snapshot', function () { const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.subscribers).to.eql([]); pm.expect(d.count).to.eql(0); pm.expect(d.total).to.eql(0); pm.expect(d.limit).to.eql(100); pm.expect(d.offset).to.eql(0); pm.expect(d.source).to.eql('asterisk_registry'); pm.expect(d.window).to.eql('full'); pm.expect(d.truncated).to.eql(false); });

request.description: Replace IMSI placeholder with a 15-digit dedicated test IMSI.

exec: pm.test('HTTP 404: example IMSI is absent from clean seed', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));
pm.test('HTTP 404: no smqueue log before cell activity', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));

request.description: Active Asterisk channels, not a lifetime call count. bridge_id is a bridge UUID, not a channel name.

exec: pm.test('HTTP 412: Asterisk is intentionally stopped', () => pm.response.to.have.status(412));

request.description: Real 18-column Asterisk CSV CDR with RFC3339 UTC timestamps; no synthetic history.

request.description: Returns the sorted current collection. Normal tests validate structure only; set verify_factory_defaults=true only against a fresh/unmodified store. / 返回当前有序列表；常规仅校验结构，仅对全新未修改预设库开启精确工厂断言。

exec: pm.test('preset list structure', function () { const items=pm.response.json().data.items; pm.expect(items).to.be.an('array'); items.forEach(function (p) { pm.expect(p).to.have.all.keys('id','name','description','params'); pm.expect(p.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(p.params).to.have.all.keys('arfcns','c0','band','mcc','mnc','lac','ci','short_name','network'); }); });

request.description: Reads the preset selected by default_preset_id without modifying it. Exact ID 0 factory fields are checked only when verify_factory_defaults=true. / 按变量只读预设；精确 ID0 工厂值仅在显式开关开启时校验。

exec: pm.test('selected preset ID and structure', function () { const p=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(p.id).to.eql(pm.variables.replaceIn('{{default_preset_id}}')); pm.expect(p).to.have.all.keys('id','name','description','params'); });

pm.test('factory default 0 exact fixture', function () { pm.expect(pm.variables.replaceIn('{{default_preset_id}}')).to.eql('0'); const p=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(p).to.eql({"id":"0","name":"addx","description":"","params":{"arfcns":"1","c0":"540","band":"1800","mcc":"001","mnc":"01","lac":"1","ci":"1","short_name":"addx","network":"eth0"}}); });

request.description: The independent lab-900 CRUD fixture is absent before guarded creation. Defaults are not targeted. / 独立 lab-900 夹具创建前不存在，不操作默认项。

item.name: Cell start / 小区启动（二选一，需开启双开关）
item.description: Choose ONE request, not Run folder. Preset and Custom call the same API with mutually exclusive bodies. Both may start RF. / 二选一手动 Send，不要运行整个分组；两者使用同一接口，参数互斥且都会启动射频。

function stop(reason) { console.error('[GSM NOT SENT / 未发送] ' + reason); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }

if (/\{\{[^}]+\}\}/.test(url) || !/^https?:\/\/[^/\s]+\/api\/v1\/cell$/.test(url) || /^https?:\/\/HOST(?=[:/]|$)/i.test(url)) { stop('Configure baseUrl as http(s)://your-server:8082 without /api/v1. / 请填写服务器 baseUrl，不附加 /api/v1。'); return; }
if (/\{\{[^}]+\}\}/.test(raw)) { stop('Unresolved body variables; fill the selected environment. / 请求体变量未解析，请补齐当前环境变量。'); return; }
let body; try { body = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (_) { stop('Body must be valid JSON. / 请求体必须为有效 JSON。'); return; }
if (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || Array.isArray(body)) { stop('Body must be a JSON object. / 请求体必须为 JSON 对象。'); return; }

if (Object.keys(body).length !== 1 || typeof body.preset_id !== 'string' || !/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$/.test(body.preset_id)) { stop('Preset start accepts only a string preset_id; set start_preset_id or use Custom start for full parameters. / 预设启动只填字符串 preset_id；请设置 start_preset_id，自定义参数请用另一启动请求。'); return; }

if (missing.length || extra.length) { stop('Custom start requires all nine string fields and no preset_id. / 自定义启动须完整九个字符串字段且不含 preset_id。 Missing / 缺少: ' + missing.join(', ') + '; unexpected / 多余: ' + extra.join(', ')); return; }
console.info('[GSM SENDING / 正在发送] ' + startMode + ' start; this may enable RF. Wait up to 90 seconds, then GET /api/v1/cell for state. / 将实际启动小区与射频，最长等待 90 秒，随后查询小区状态。');
